basic_info.description: Green Hills Views Cottages are being offered for the 1st time for lease! Live in a super prime Russian Hill hideaway compound close to the financial district & Polk St Action. 3 Cottage structures surround a historic huge oak tree on double lot of pathways and rock gardens. Main House is a 2BR/1BA with kitchen, 2 decks, luxurious bath with a skylight to observe the oak tree while soaking. The guest house has a bigger kitchen and full bath with skylight over black and white tiled stall shower. Both light-filled houses have hardwood floors, fireplaces, views and built-in lighting. The 3rd structure has a long room with 3 windows and can lighting, laundry room & storage room. A city gardeners dream come true with owner open to tenants vision.
